limitations: A 24-hour installed resource observation remains pending.

Claude can omit required status fields in otherwise successful metadata responses. Prior verified data retains its original age and becomes unavailable after its freshness limit; it is not renewed by an incomplete response.
The Store edition remains a preview. Distribution provisioning, the owner encryption answer, final account scope, TestFlight and App Store submission remain unresolved or unperformed.

A large Codex history that keeps growing can remain in verification until a stable interval. When foreground and background work are both queued, the per-scan foreground byte allowance is 112 MiB; a larger prefix may not finish verification while appends continue.
When Claude project metadata is unchanged, cached reply-identity verification can defer a recheck by up to 60 seconds plus the normal polling and read delay.

Recorded Store preview 69 workflows do not establish successful source grants, Store provider handoff, notifications, Open at Login, complete keyboard coverage, spoken VoiceOver, exact macOS 13 behavior or closed-window visibility.
publication_scope: Public backup contains only manifest-allowlisted source, sanitized build and distribution receipts, and the exact notarized direct-download ZIP and DMG. No private diagnostics, state databases, test chats, screenshots or working scripts.
